findings.gate_chain: ReadLease (2.6) runs before PsMappedImageCaller checks (2.7-2.10) before permits_code (2.11): OwnedMappedImageCaller.hpp:55-57 (provider variant, the composed one; :48-50 read-lease variant). contains({0,0})=true / contains({0,1})=false is PsMappedImageCaller.hpp:24-25; ctor wraps scalar text_base as {text_base,1} at :68 so adapter text_base=0 can never pass; permits_code demands R|X segments (hpp:57,69,39); lease demands R per registered page (OwnedMemory.cpp:121-126).
findings.r8_premise_correction: With staged units r8 still dies at 2.6, not 2.9: adapter derive_readable_ranges (lmf_to_native_loader_facts.cpp:74-103) never filters by protection, composed supplier records the exec-only anchor mapping (live_module_facts.cpp:443-459), so readable_ranges=[{0x400000,0x787c000}) while the bridge registers R-only spans starting 0x787c000 (runtime_start_bridge_r8.cpp:398-421). Supplier-side filtering is NOT an option (anchor_mapping_count would hit 0 -> conversion refusal, lmf cpp:155-158); the filter belongs in the adapter (satellite diff A).
findings.probe_precedent: Probe A (test_lmf_adapter_host.cpp:458-478) host-proves contains({0,1}) fails on adapter facts with everything earlier passing (S1 REPORT.md:149). Probe C (:501-519) host-proves permits_code requires R|X registration of the covering segment (REPORT.md:151). A registered-pages configuration where text_base=0x400000 passes BOTH exists service-side only (register text R|X; ScopedRegion accepts it, OwnedMemory.cpp:41-44) but is a hardware lie on this target (VMMAP prot=4; igf6 blocked read, mechanism user-amended to not-localized, no re-probe directive).
findings.consumer_audit: No reader of view().text_base exists anywhere: not in the candidate collectors, not in OwnedSerializedElfSource, not in the vendored patternsleuth Rust crate (zero grep hits). text_base=0 views are therefore inert metadata downstream.
